rationale: The current contracts are sufficiently specified. F002 is superseded by the confirmed placement in DOMAIN_SPEC.md §2.1.1 and is already asserted by the Profit component test. Existing resolution component tests cover compact presentation and root-sourcing text, but browser smoke fixtures suppress that text. A new Bank/Materials header contract test is prepared; browser fixture changes remain a precise implementation specification.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Reconcile Bank and Materials page headers with the shared page-header contract while preserving focus and reload behavior.
acceptance_checks.expected: Each screen renders its heading in the shared .page-head structure with tabindex=-1 and data-page-heading; its reload control is grouped in page-actions and still invokes the existing reload behavior.
acceptance_checks.verification: Run AccountPageHeaderContract.spec.ts plus the existing BankScreen.spec.ts and MaterialsScreen.spec.ts.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Preserve maximum displayed recipe count and Show all beside the results title, with accessible calculation and filter groups.
acceptance_checks.expected: Maximum and Show all remain in the opportunities toolbar beside the title, outside Calculation controls; calculation and displayed-result controls retain their distinct groups.
acceptance_checks.verification: Existing CraftingProfitScreen.spec.ts test keepsSearchAndFiltersInDisplayedResultsAndPlacesTheLimitInTheOpportunitiesToolbar asserts the placement and grouping. Preserve it; no UI change is warranted.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Align compact-value documentation and behavior with both crafting workflows.
acceptance_checks.expected: Both workflows show the compact effective value presentation and omit the non-compact cost/basis branches; remove unreachable branches only if the implementation confirms they are unused and within scope.
acceptance_checks.verification: Existing CraftingResolution.spec.ts, CraftingProfitScreen.spec.ts, and CraftingDiscoveryScreen.spec.ts cover compact workflow presentation. Correct the prop documentation if implementation confirms it is stale.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Exercise root-sourcing presentation in controlled-browser smoke coverage.
acceptance_checks.expected: At least one fixture in each relevant crafting workflow reaches a tree whose root recipe identity differs from the requested recipe, and the rendered resolution-root-sourcing text matches the supplied identities. Keep the same-recipe suppression assertion where separately useful.
acceptance_checks.verification: Update the controlled Profit and Discovery smoke fixture/checks to render and assert the sourcing sentence; use fixture responses, with no live API dependency.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Add or update focused checks for changed contracts while retaining meaningful workflow assertions.
acceptance_checks.expected: The prepared header test verifies shared structure, focus semantics, and grouped reload actions; existing focused tests and smoke checks continue to assert their current workflow behavior.
acceptance_checks.verification: Run the focused component suites and affected controlled-browser smoke checks after implementation.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Disposition findings that are already resolved or superseded.
acceptance_checks.expected: Record F002 as superseded by the confirmed DOMAIN_SPEC §2.1.1 decision and preserve its current implementation. Record current component evidence for compact presentation and root-sourcing, while noting the browser coverage gap.
acceptance_checks.verification: Review the named source sections, component specs, and smoke assertions in the story Result.

invariants: Navigation focus targets the destination heading through tabindex=-1 and data-page-heading.
Bank and Materials reload actions remain available in the page header and retain their existing reload behavior.
The display maximum and Show all affect displayed rows only and remain beside the results title, outside Calculation controls.
Calculation controls and displayed-result filters retain separate accessible groupings.
Resolution values and recipe identities remain backend-supplied; the frontend formats and presents them without reconstructing domain results.
Root-sourcing prose reflects the supplied root recipe identity relative to the requested recipe; a matching identity is not redundantly described.
existing_tests_reviewed: frontend/src/crafting/__tests__/CraftingProfitScreen.spec.ts — asserts maximum and Show all placement, separate control groups, heading, filters, and workflow behavior.
frontend/src/crafting/__tests__/CraftingResolution.spec.ts — asserts compact presentation and the root-sourcing outcomes for inventory-only, matching-recipe, and different-recipe roots.
frontend/src/crafting/__tests__/profitResolutionAssociation.spec.ts — covers root-sourcing text through the Profit association path.
frontend/src/crafting/__tests__/CraftingDiscoveryScreen.spec.ts — covers Discovery workflow controls, heading, and reload behavior.
frontend/src/account/__tests__/BankScreen.spec.ts — covers Bank reads and reload behavior, but not shared header structure.
frontend/src/account/__tests__/MaterialsScreen.spec.ts — covers Materials reads and reload behavior, but not shared header structure.
frontend/scripts/profit-browser-smoke.mjs — asserts compact presentation and currently requires root-sourcing text to be absent for its matching-recipe fixture.
frontend/scripts/discovery-browser-smoke.mjs — asserts compact presentation and currently requires root-sourcing text to be absent for its matching-recipe fixture.
test_specifications: For Bank and Materials, mount each screen with FakeAccountApi and assert .page-head contains the correctly named page-heading with tabindex=-1 and data-page-heading, and page-actions contains the screen's reload control.

In the controlled Profit browser smoke fixture, return a resolution tree whose root recipeId differs from the requested recipe ID; assert resolution-root-sourcing displays the sentence identifying the supplied selected recipe and requested recipe.

In the controlled Discovery browser smoke fixture, return a root with no selected recipe or a different recipe ID; assert the corresponding describeRootSourcing sentence renders. Keep its existing same-recipe suppression assertion if a separate matching fixture remains.
Retain the existing Profit placement assertion and component coverage for compact values and resolution behavior; do not change expected placement to the obsolete Calculation-controls location.

pre_implementation_verification.failure_evidence: The command did not reach Vitest test collection. Node exited with EPERM while resolving its runtime path, reporting lstat 'C:\Users\Administrator'. The shell environment also showed the same error when launched from the frontend directory. This is an environment failure, not behavior-level expected-red evidence.

coverage_review: docs/QUALITY_METRICS.md provides a measured frontend snapshot dated 2026-10-03: 92.88% line and 85.22% branch coverage overall, below the 90% branch warning target. Reported source-area coverage includes crafting at 94.02% line / 85.63% branch and account at 98.88% line / 86.84% branch. No screen-level report was available in the inspected report summary. Review updated affected coverage after implementation; do not add tests merely to raise the KPI.
post_implementation_review_reason: Required because controlled-browser smoke fixture coverage is currently missing for rendered root-sourcing output, and the prepared header test could not run in this environment. Verify the smoke assertions against the actual rendered pages and review affected frontend coverage.

post_implementation_reviews.reason: The implementation matches the acceptance criteria, and the story records focused component and controlled-browser checks passing. The prepared header test remains present and meaningful with its protected SHA-256 unchanged. The stated scope changes and F002 disposition are supported by the inspected contracts and assertions. The supplied focused WEB-021 run evidence was not treated as verification for WEB-028; review relies on the WEB-028 results recorded in the story.
evidence: The Bank and Materials header contract test asserts the shared header, correct heading, tabindex=-1, data-page-heading, and grouped reload control. Its SHA-256 matches the QA plan’s protected hash.

The story reports 246 component tests passing, the focused placement assertion passing, and both controlled-browser smoke checks passing with assertions for rendered root-sourcing text and same-recipe suppression.
Inspected smoke fixtures use a different root recipe for Profit and a stock-sourced root for Discovery, exercising distinct root-sourcing messages.
F002 is recorded as superseded by DOMAIN_SPEC §2.1.1; the existing placement assertion remains, and the story reports the matching browser assertion passing.
The QA plan notes the 2026-10-03 branch-coverage snapshot is below its warning target and requests review without adding tests solely to raise the metric.
